messages:
deploy-bot: Release paused — deploy-bot detected configmap mount-order mismatch between staging and prod for service `inference-gateway`. Blocking promotion until triage. diff: https://deploybot.internal/diffs/2146004321 :warning:

oliver: mount-order mismatch? can you paste the diff?

deploy-bot: Attached summary: staging mounts `main-config` before `sidecar-config`; prod has them reversed. This causes sidecar to initialize with empty config and fail init probe in prod.

maya: confirmed. Root cause was PR #429 that reordered volumeMounts in helm values to place sidecar first (was aiming to consolidate mounts). Staging got the chart change during canary, prod didn't — but prod chart template uses a different merge strategy so ordering diverged.

sanjay: can we hotfix by pinning image or by changing helm chart in prod? We're inside the 22:00-23:30 change window so small restarts are OK.

phil: pinning image won't change mount order. Need to either patch the pod spec in prod (kubectl patch) or promote the fixed chart. Patch is fastest but is a manual divergence from helm-managed state.

kate: I can open a minimal patch for the helm chart to explicitly set volumeMount ordering and bump chart patch. Also can do an immediate kubectl patch on prod to unblock. Suggest: change templates/deployment.yaml to render volumeMounts with explicit ordering key.

oliver: agreed. @kate do the k8s patch and PR. We should also add a short note to release notes that a mount-order fix was applied and that chart will be pinned until next full rollout.

kate: preparing patch now. propose immediate non-disruptive kubectl patch (no downtime expected, pods will restart):

```bash
kubectl -n prod patch deployment inference-gateway --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/volumeMounts","value":[{"name":"main-config","mountPath":"/etc/inference/conf"},{"name":"sidecar-config","mountPath":"/etc/sidecar/conf"}]}]'
```

kate: will run the patch on prod-inference-us-west1 once I have 👍 from SRE.

maya: +1 from me. after patch we should run smoke and a small inference load.

sanjay: @phil can you watch metrics and set alert if error rate >0.5% or latency > 25% p95 during canary? If so, we will rollback.

phil: watching. i will tail gateway logs and the canary dashboard. will post timestamps.

kate: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference-helm/pull/432 — title: fix(volumeMounts): enforce main-config first to avoid init races. includes unit test for template ordering.

kate: applying kubectl patch to prod now. patch started at 2146004480.

deploy-bot: Patch applied to cluster prod-inference-us-west1. New pods rolled at 2146004482. Starting health checks.

phil: seeing new pods come up. logs show sidecar reading config OK now. preliminary 10m smoke: 0 errors, p95 latency stable.

maya: running inference smoke script (smoke_inference.sh) against canary pods. Small spike in restarts observed but recovered. no user-facing errors.

oliver: good. @release-manager-bot once we have green smoke and metrics for 10m can we resume release? we should also pin chart version in the release notes and add a follow-up ticket to reconcile helm state (helm release vs k8s patch).

release-manager-bot: Release resume approved. Conditions met: smoke passed, metrics within thresholds. Release unpaused at 2146004560. Note: deploy-bot will record a manual patch in release notes and create ticket INF-2146 to reconcile helm state.

oliver: create INF-2146 and assign to @kate for reconciliation and to add helm-linter check to CI to catch mount-order changes.

kate: created ticket INF-2146 and linked PR. will backport fix to 1.2.x and pin chart to 1.2.10 for the immediate release.

sanjay: decision: do not rollback. we will promote current image with the patched mount ordering and pin chart until next maintenance window. update changelog with short note: "fix: enforce volumeMount ordering for inference-gateway (prod patch)".

oliver: thanks all. follow-ups: (1) INF-2146 reconcile helm state, (2) add helm template ordering unit test to CI, (3) add a quick pre-promotion check in deploy-bot to validate volumeMount order between environments.

maya: noted. adding to retro agenda for root-cause: why staging/prod merge rules drifted.

phil: monitoring continues for next 30m. will alert if anything looks off.

deploy-bot: Recorded action: release paused -> manual patch -> release resumed. Patch link: https://deploybot.internal/patches/2146004321.

oliver: closing thread, will include note in the release notes and final changelog entry. :white_check_mark:
